description: This file contains the implementation of the ClientClusterManifestProvider class, which manages and provides cluster manifest information for external clients in an Orleans distributed system. It handles the lifecycle, background updating, and merging of cluster state data from gateways.

classes.name: ClientClusterManifestProvider
classes.description: An internal class implementing IClusterManifestProvider for external clients, managing cluster state manifests.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the cluster manifest provider background process.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully stops the provider, canceling background tasks.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: The main background loop that fetches and updates cluster manifests.

methods.name: GetClusterManifestUpdate
methods.description: Fetches an update of the cluster manifest from the provider, falling back if needed.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes the provider, stopping background activities.
